ramanagara.name: Ramanagara (CMC / taluk)

ramanagara.headline: Treatment gaps unchanged for 4+ years, despite a sanctioned upgrade

sources.says: ~18.9-23.3 MLD generated vs 17.5 MLD installed STP capacity (district); Ramanagara STP 'not adequate'; treated/untreated volumes 'Not Estimated'.

streams.summary: No common effluent treatment plant; the documents contradict each other on whether that's a problem

metrics.label: DEP position
metrics.value: Effluent "fully recycled, zero discharge"; 581 industries "meeting standards" (DEP 2021)

metrics.label: CAG finding
metrics.value: 38 of 66 sampled KIADB areas had no CETP; ~2,571 ML/yr untreated (CAG 2017)

sources.says: "There are no CETPs in the Ramanagara District." Trade effluent reported fully recycled with zero discharge; all 581 wastewater-discharging industries reported meeting standards.

sources.says: "No common ETPs in the Arkavathi catchment area" - restated unchanged while the industry count grew 144 -> 191.
